description: This is a C++ header file defining the CMAgent class, which serves as a stub interface for a CM (Content Management) agent. It declares methods for handling JSON-RPC calls related to CM management, such as Get, Set, AddObject, DelObject, and others. It also includes class inheritance, constructor setup with method bindings, and various stub functions for CM agent operations.

classes.name: CMAgent
classes.description: A stub class implementing various CM agent functions using JSON-RPC; inherits from RDKTestStubInterface and AbstractServer, providing methods for CM management tasks.

methods.name: CMAgent_Get
methods.description: Handles the JSON-RPC request to retrieve a parameter value from the CM agent.

methods.name: CMAgent_GetAttr
methods.description: Retrieves attributes of a specified parameter in the CM agent.

methods.name: CMAgent_SetAttr
methods.description: Sets attributes for a specified parameter in the CM agent.

methods.name: CMAgent_GetNames
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CM object names based on provided path and recursive flag.

methods.name: CMAgent_Set
methods.description: Sets a parameter value within the CM agent.

methods.name: CMAgent_Set_Get
methods.description: Gets and sets parameter values in the CM agent.

methods.name: CMAgent_AddObject
methods.description: Adds a new object in the CM system.

methods.name: CMAgent_DelObject
methods.description: Deletes an object in the CM system.

methods.name: CMAgent_SetCommit
methods.description: Commits configuration changes within the CM system.

methods.name: CMAgent_GetHealth
methods.description: Retrieves health status information from the CM system.

methods.name: CMAgent_SetSessionId
methods.description: Sets session parameters for the CM agent.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the CM agent with a specific version.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources for the specified version of the CM agent.
